notes: This is a typescript with extensive pen corrections and a slanted left-margin addition. It continues a preceding assertion, then gives parts (iii) and (iv). There is no title, date, salutation, mathematical diagram or independent body page number; 16 is the archive foliation.

The opening corrections replace the group expression by Z^+=Z cap U and the additive acting algebra by Lie(Z^+)=g^e cap Fil^1(g). The margin records a factorization of Z and identifies Z_o with Z cap L=Cent(f). The live affine phrase remains a+g^e; no harmonizing correction is visible.

Part (iii) describes the open dense locus of eligible e in g(2), shifts the label g(2)* to a later position, and changes underlined torseur to espace homogène under L=Cent(x)=Cent(i). Part (iv) defines P,U,L by their Lie algebras and states independence and orbit-map properties.

No explicit question or verbal hesitation is written on this page. The author’s visible revisions include cancelled centralizer descriptions, the change of the opening hypothesis of (iv), and several inserted identifications. Reported uncertainty is reader uncertainty, not supplied author prose.

The live affine expression and its complete adjacent punctuation were checked on retained half a at whole-image bbox [262,391,915,456]: a+g^e, pour un a in g convenable). The mathematical issue is discussed only in math_checks.

The final e in ad(g).e has a clear loop and long baseline terminal in crop 16. Its thick ink does not yield an independently legible predecessor, so none was invented. The mapsto tee and right arrowhead are distinct.

All agreement loci were read as well as contested loci: accents and ends of the prose lines, the G_m underlines, the three Lie definitions, the filtration indices 1/3/k, the j>=k sum, the two mapsto arrows, and the final stars were checked from the permitted halves. No general theorem was treated as verified merely because its wording was transcribed.

Typed operator capitals remain ordinary upright capitals. The raised Lie(i)(1) L has a heavy/doubled impression but no secure distinct mathematical alphabet. Weight alone was not used to make it blackboard bold. Handwriting wrapper differences alone were not counted.

H’s dot notation (cdot versus a plain dot), equivalent arrow lengths and emph-versus-underline syntax were treated as equivalent notation where the source object is the same; source dot positions are retained in reading.tex. The independently missing underline on the cancelled torseur is reported separately.

math_checks.place: Live a+g^e versus corrected acting Lie algebra
math_checks.method: Exact 2 by 2 commutator computation with E=[[0,1],[0,0]], H=diag(1,-1), F=[[0,0],[1,0]] and A=aH+bE+cF, carried out using SymPy; then direct-sum reasoning in characteristic zero.
math_checks.result: [E,A]=[[c,-2a],[0,-c]], [H,E]=2E, [H,F]=-2F. Hence the centralizer of E in sl2 is kE. Adding a direct central summand kz gives g^E=kE+ kz while Fil^1(g)=kE, so g^E cap Fil^1(g) can be strictly smaller than g^E. Thus the surviving affine phrase does not automatically follow from the corrected acting algebra.
math_checks.limit: This tests a concrete algebraic possibility, not the general hypotheses of the surrounding document. No other page was consulted. The source reading a+g^e was retained unchanged.
